name: RoseNeRF
aliases: Refracting once is enough for NeRF
definition: A framework for high-fidelity novel view synthesis of refractive objects that simplifies complex ray interactions inside objects to a single refraction event, mapping an incoming ray to its refracted counterpart without requiring additional information like masks or Index of Refraction (IoR).
summary: RoseNeRF enables high-fidelity novel view synthesis of refractive objects by predicting refracted rays via a 4D light field, avoiding the need for index of refraction fields or detailed surface reconstructions.
